title: dennstaedtia cicutaria var. erosa
intro: Dennstaedtia cicutaria var. erosa, commonly known as the Forked Cinnamon Fern, is a type of fern plant belonging to the Dennstaedtiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Dennstaedtia cicutaria var. erosa include its ability to reduce fever, treat wounds, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
